changeSet.author: tymur
changeSet.comment: Dedup on the immutable OLX/Otodom ad id, not the full URL. A seller editing the title changes the slug (…-CID3-ID1bA1FD.html) while the -ID token stays, which under the old md5(url) key looked brand-new and re-posted the listing. Collapse existing rows onto the new key so redeploy does not re-flood the channel: drop duplicates (keep earliest), then rewrite offer_hash. Rows with no -ID segment keep their full-URL hash unchanged.
changeSet.sql: DELETE FROM feed_offers f USING ( SELECT id, row_number() OVER ( PARTITION BY feed_id, md5(coalesce(substring(url from '-ID([0-9A-Za-z]+)'), url)) ORDER BY id ) AS rn FROM feed_offers ) dup WHERE f.id = dup.id AND dup.rn > 1
UPDATE feed_offers SET offer_hash = md5(coalesce(substring(url from '-ID([0-9A-Za-z]+)'), url)) WHERE offer_hash <> md5(coalesce(substring(url from '-ID([0-9A-Za-z]+)'), url))

changeSet.author: tymur
changeSet.comment: Same ad-id dedup for the IKEA furniture channel (furniture_offers). Collapse duplicates onto the new key so redeploy does not re-post edited-slug listings.
changeSet.sql: DELETE FROM furniture_offers f USING ( SELECT id, row_number() OVER ( PARTITION BY feed_id, md5(coalesce(substring(url from '-ID([0-9A-Za-z]+)'), url)) ORDER BY id ) AS rn FROM furniture_offers ) dup WHERE f.id = dup.id AND dup.rn > 1
UPDATE furniture_offers SET offer_hash = md5(coalesce(substring(url from '-ID([0-9A-Za-z]+)'), url)) WHERE offer_hash <> md5(coalesce(substring(url from '-ID([0-9A-Za-z]+)'), url))
